The core of this framework is an unpaired Brain Disk Schrödinger Bridge (BDSB) diffusion model, which is applied after aligning 3T and 7T fMRI data from different subjects into a shared parametric domain. The BDSB model is trained to learn the transformation from the 3T data distribution to the 7T data distribution, effectively improving the quality of the 3T data.
